**Given:** AC and the closed compact oriented smooth manifold of dimension one or two.

[A1] [[def-axiom-of-choice]] covers the inherited countable-choice hypotheses of smooth classification and Morse theory.

[F1] [[lem-a-compact-connected-one-dimensional-manifold-without-boundary-is-a-circle]] proves the smooth diffeomorphism classification of each nonempty connected compact one-manifold without boundary.

[F2] [[thm-adapted-excellent-morse-functions-exist-on-compact-cobordisms]], [[thm-morse-rearrangement-by-index]] and [[thm-morse-functions-and-handle-decompositions-correspond]] supply a finite index-ordered smooth disk/band/capping-disk presentation of any closed smooth surface; their hypotheses allow empty incoming and outgoing faces in dimension two.

[F3] [[lem-polygonal-schema-reduction-moves]] proves, by explicit finite diagonal splits and merges, cancellation of adjacent inverse sides and extraction of an interlaced opposite-direction pair into a commutator block. [[lem-finite-c2-surface-carriers-have-smooth-normal-forms-and-relative-cap-approximations]] supplies smooth disk, annulus, disk-and-band tree contraction, and boundary-circle extension constructions; in its proof the explicit positive-derivative collar maps are used below, rather than a general smooth-structure uniqueness theorem.

[F4] [[def-unoriented-and-oriented-bordism-groups]] identifies a zero oriented bordism class with an actual compact smooth oriented filling of the single manifold, and uses disjoint union as addition.

items.facts_section_exact:
**Given:** AC and marked CW models $K_m=K(\mathbb Z,m)$.

[A1] [[def-axiom-of-choice]] is inherited from the cohomology, fibration and CW suppliers.

[F1] [[lem-circle-and-path-loop-models-for-eilenberg-maclane-induction]] identifies the actual strict fiber of $PK_m\to K_m$ with $K_{m-1}$ and contracts its total space. [[ex-path-loop-serre-computation-of-cp-infinity]] identifies $K_2$ with $\mathbb {CP}^{\infty}$; [[lem-cohomology-ring-of-infinite-complex-projective-space]] computes its integral cohomology as $\mathbb Z[a]$, $|a|=2$, and its degreewise finite homology.

[F2] [[thm-homological-serre-spectral-sequence]], [[thm-cohomological-serre-spectral-sequence]] and [[thm-multiplicative-structure-on-the-cohomological-serre-spectral-sequence]] supply the actual constant-system sequences, strong convergence, and the total-degree Leibniz rule. [[thm-absolute-hurewicz-theorem]] makes $K_m$ $(m-1)$-connected with its first integral homology $\mathbb Z$ in degree $m$. [[thm-relative-hurewicz-theorem]] identifies the first relative disk class of the contractible path total and its simply connected fiber with the corresponding relative homology generator.

[F3] [[thm-topological-universal-coefficient-short-exact-sequence-for-cohomology]], [[thm-universal-coefficient-theorem-for-homology-over-a-pid]] and [[cor-fundamental-theorem-of-finitely-generated-abelian-groups-from-pid-modules]] give coefficient comparisons and the cyclic decomposition. [[thm-rational-cohomology-of-eilenberg-maclane-spaces-in-one-generator]] computes rational cohomology as a polynomial algebra on the degree-$m$ fundamental class for even $m$, and an exterior algebra for odd $m$.

[F4] [[thm-borel-polynomial-base-from-a-transgressive-simple-fiber-system]] proves the mod-two polynomial-base comparison for a transgressive simple fiber system. [[lem-relative-lifts-produce-cohomological-transgressions]] proves the relative-lift transgression statement and its compatibility with each square, with the actual strict fiber.

[F5] [[def-mod-two-square-algebra-admissible-sequences-and-excess]], [[thm-adem-relations-for-steenrod-squares]] and [[prop-steenrod-square-normalization-instability-and-top-square]] fix admissibility, excess, Adem reduction, instability and top squares. [[lem-reduction-of-the-integral-bockstein-is-the-first-steenrod-square]] gives $Sq^1=\rho_2\beta_{\mathbb Z}$.

items.facts_section_exact:
**Given:** AC and the oriented smooth manifolds, collars, parametrizations and nonempty $W_0$ in the Statement.

[A1] [[def-axiom-of-choice]] is inherited from the integral bordism and collar suppliers.

[F1] [[thm-signature-classifies-oriented-smooth-four-bordism]] proves that a closed oriented smooth four-manifold of zero signature has an actual compact oriented smooth five-dimensional filling, integrally and with arbitrary fundamental group.

[F2] [[thm-collar-neighborhood-theorem]] supplies a collar of that filling's boundary. [[lem-collar-gluing-and-corner-smoothing-give-transitivity]] proves smooth gluing in signed collars and its orientation convention, with collar comparisons supported at the seam.

[F3] [[thm-mayer-vietoris-sequence-in-singular-homology]] and [[def-middle-dimensional-intersection-form]] compute the middle form of a connected sum by disjoint punctured-summand cycles. [[ex-signature-and-p-one-of-complex-projective-two-space]] gives signature one for the complex-oriented projective plane; [[lem-signature-is-additive-under-disjoint-union-and-orientation-reversal]] gives the opposite sign after orientation reversal.

items.facts_section_exact:
**Given:** AC and the geometric oriented bordism groups of closed smooth manifolds.

[A1] [[def-axiom-of-choice]] is inherited from the Thom, classifying-space, UCT and Hurewicz suppliers.

[F1] [[lem-closed-oriented-smooth-one-and-two-manifolds-bound]] and [[thm-every-closed-oriented-smooth-three-manifold-bounds-a-compact-oriented-smooth-four-manifold]] give actual integral single-copy fillings in dimensions one, two and three. [[thm-universal-pontryagin-thom-correspondence-for-unoriented-and-oriented-bordism]] identifies geometric oriented bordism with the stable homotopy of the universal oriented Thom prespectrum.

[F2] [[lem-integral-eilenberg-maclane-offset-five-homology-vanishes]] proves $H_{q+5}(K(\mathbb Z,q);\mathbb Z)=0$ for $q\ge8$, including the integral degreewise finite-generation and all primary calculations.

[F3] [[thm-bo-bso-cohomology-away-from-two]] computes the actual $BSO(q)$ cohomology over $\mathbb Q$ and every odd-prime field. [[thm-mod-two-cohomology-of-bo-n]] gives $H^*(BO(q);\mathbb F_2)=\mathbb F_2[w_1,\ldots,w_q]$. [[thm-gysin-long-exact-sequence-of-an-oriented-sphere-bundle]] applies with the canonical mod-two orientation also to the determinant line bundle and its sphere double cover. [[lem-oriented-grassmannian-has-two-lifted-schubert-cells]] gives finite generation of integral homology in every degree.

[F4] [[thm-real-splitting-principle-with-mod-two-injective-pullback]], [[thm-cartan-formula-for-steenrod-squares]] and [[prop-steenrod-square-normalization-instability-and-top-square]] compute $Sq^1$ by roots. [[lem-reduction-of-the-integral-bockstein-is-the-first-steenrod-square]], [[thm-topological-universal-coefficient-short-exact-sequence-for-cohomology]] and [[cor-fundamental-theorem-of-finitely-generated-abelian-groups-from-pid-modules]] detect primary cyclic summands.

[F5] [[lem-universal-oriented-sphere-bundle-has-bso-n-minus-one-total-space]] gives the actual $S^q$-fibration with total homotopy equivalent to $BSO(q)$ over $BSO(q+1)$, with the tautological bundle splitting as a line plus the complement. [[lem-a-connected-cw-pair-has-a-model-without-low-relative-cells]] and [[thm-freudenthal-suspension-theorem]] give the relative cell model and suspension comparison. [[lem-cw-quotients-and-collapse-of-a-contractible-subcomplex]] compares reduced and unreduced suspensions by collapsing the basepoint meridian. [[thm-homotopy-invariance-of-vector-bundle-pullback]] transports the finite-rank bundle across the relative CW equivalence. [[thm-thom-isomorphism-for-oriented-vector-bundles]] gives the integral and mod-two Thom isomorphisms, and [[thm-thom-identity-for-stiefel-whitney-classes]] gives $Sq^i\bar u=w_i\bar u$.

[F6] [[thm-eilenberg-maclane-spaces-represent-singular-cohomology]], [[thm-mapping-path-factorization]], [[thm-long-exact-sequence-of-homotopy-groups-of-a-fibration]], [[thm-absolute-hurewicz-theorem]], [[thm-cw-approximation-of-an-arbitrary-space]], [[lem-weak-homotopy-equivalences-induce-integral-homology-isomorphisms-without-choice]] and [[thm-homological-serre-spectral-sequence]] supply the represented Thom-class map, its actual homotopy fiber and the homotopy/homology comparisons.

[F7] [[thm-signature-is-an-oriented-cobordism-invariant]] supplies the additive integral signature, [[ex-signature-and-p-one-of-complex-projective-two-space]] gives $\sigma(\mathbb {CP}^2)=1$, and [[thm-rational-oriented-bordism-is-detected-by-pontryagin-numbers]] gives rational rank one. [[lem-rationalization-is-exact-and-commutes-with-singular-homology]] identifies the kernel of rationalization with torsion. [[def-unoriented-and-oriented-bordism-groups]] identifies a zero geometric class with an actual compact oriented smooth filling.
